summary: Full backend test run for J.P. The Handyman API completed successfully. 20/20 pytest tests passed in 49s including all AI vision (Gemini 2.5 Flash) and TTS (OpenAI via Emergent LLM key) endpoints. Coverage: health, dev-login auth + Bearer protection, jobs CRUD with auto-seed of 4 demo jobs, photo upload, AI analyze-job/diagnostic/safety (text-only + with-image), voice/greet with MP3 audio validation, and logout token invalidation. All endpoints honor /api prefix, exclude Mongo _id, validate Pydantic input, and return appropriate HTTP status codes (400/401/404/502).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 665 lines — borderline; consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, ai, voice) before it grows further.

AnalyzeRequest/DiagnosticRequest require image_base64 but there is no server-side size cap; a malicious client could OOM the process with a huge base64 string. Add max-length validator on the Pydantic models.
Photos are stored as full base64 inside the job document — Mongo 16MB doc limit will be hit after a handful of high-res photos. Consider GridFS or external object storage.
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated since 0.93; migrate to lifespan context manager.
POST /api/auth/dev-login is a tester shortcut and is currently always-on in production; gate it behind an env flag (e.g., ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN=true) before shipping.
/api/jobs/{job_id}/photos and PATCH responses re-fetch the job after write — fine for now, but consider returning the updated doc from update_one + ReturnDocument.AFTER to save a round-trip.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded 4 demo jobs for tester@jphandy.dev via first GET /api/jobs call (server-side seeder). Created one additional TEST_ job during CRUD test. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 requested backend flows verified green via pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_jp_handyman_backend.py. Use BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 and dev-login (tester@jphandy.dev) for Bearer token. AI calls take 5-30s; AI_TIMEOUT=90s is sufficient. Auto-seed of 4 demo jobs is idempotent per user. If retesting after server.py changes, also run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v.
